head: 17d21b3f23481b13d2ae3a02fae130fddbe8c939
scope: Whole current implementation, including code already present in first core commit; standards and contract review, read-only target.

importantFindings.title: Keep a rejected replacement source blocked through placement edits
importantFindings.scenario: Load a valid transparent PNG, select a scene, replace it with an invalid or opaque PNG, then edit centerX or another placement control. configure() renders the retained source and resets status to ready/error to null/retained to false, re-enabling save/export although no valid replacement source was selected.
importantFindings.contract: A failed replacement may retain a clearly labelled previous preview, but cannot export/save until a valid source is selected. A later rejected edit cannot label old output current.

evidence.reviewerFocusedRepro: Actual SceneSession/parser/math with browser primitives doubled: valid source -> rejected replacement (file_format,error,retained=true,canPrepare=false) -> configure(40,500,800) -> ready,retained=false,canPrepare=true -> prepare returns prepared for previous source hash.
evidence.parentReportedBrowserRepro: Parent separately reported actual owner Chrome: opaque.png rejected alpha_opaque; centerX 500->450 removed error and enabled prepare/save against retained 519-byte source. No save performed; revision remained 0.

importantFindings.suggestedFix: Track source acceptance/rejection independently from geometry validity. configure/select must preserve a rejected-source block; clear it only on a newly accepted source or identity reset. Add real app integration regression for replacement failure followed by placement edit.

importantFindings.title: Apply unknown-outcome guard to admin account creation
importantFindings.scenario: When POST /api/users loses its response, fail() sets unknownWrite and asks for a refresh, but the user-form handler bypasses write() and does not inspect unknownWrite or revalidating. A second explicit submit sends another POST before any current GET.
importantFindings.contract: Unknown network write outcome may be after commit: say outcome unknown, require explicit current GET, never auto-resend.

evidence.reviewerFocusedRepro: Actual app.js with disposable DOM/fetch primitives: request log GET /api/session, GET /api/state, POST /api/users (TypeError), POST /api/users; no intervening GET. The UI displayed outcome unknown / refresh first after the first POST. No actual server/accounts/database used.

importantFindings.suggestedFix: Guard account creation with the same saving/unknownWrite/revalidating discipline as workspace writes, and disable its submit control while blocked. Recovery should require a successful explicit current GET. Include focused integration coverage.

minorFindings.title: Header account controls are sized below the documented 44px target
minorFindings.evidence: The .account select and .account button rules set min-height:38px, overriding the general 44px button target. Their padding/font sizing does not raise them to 44px.
minorFindings.suggestedFix: Use at least 44px for these actionable controls; verify actual computed dimensions during the separate browser/UI acceptance.

standardsAssessment: One minor explicit target-size mismatch. No additional important documented-standard defect confirmed. Compressed formatting was observed but is not reported as a hard violation.
specAssessment: Two focused recovery/guard defects confirmed. Store/HTTP validation, strict row/event binding, CAS, source/placement math, PNG framing and rendering order were inspected; no further important defect confirmed in this source review.

verification.priorFullSuite: Parent supplied 52 passing TAP tests; suite not rerun for freshness. Tests were read.
verification.permanentRuntimeAccess: No access or mutation; no auth/private DB read, no restart, no persistent server launched.

limitations: Browser primitives were doubled in reviewer focused repros; they are not browser-pixel evidence.
No browser/pixel/preservation/UI release verdict. Parent browser reproduction is attributed, not claimed as reviewer execution.
No public release/count/CI/ZIP approval; programme39/624 remains outside this scoped review.
